reviewMethod: Twelve original PNGs inspected with view_image, six expected/actual pairs at 1920x1080, 2560x1440 and 3840x2160. No pixel editing or re-encoding. Exactly the six scientific actual PNG bytes copied after review.

references.review: Viewed original expected and actual images side by side: large localized 0,5, formula and labelled canonical 0.5 retained; readable light/dark tokens, complete copy controls. Increased result-card height is the commissioned visible change; 1920 workspace uses its existing scroll area. No palette or other-mode reference replacement.
